title: IPD-12 Substrate Engine Schema
description: Defines the 4×4×4 substrate primitives for the IPD-12 Intransitive Prime Engine using dual-binary substrate pairs, triadic observer modes, RTT regime shells, and prime-indexed operator states.

substrate_pair.description: Dual-binary substrate primitive: S1=(0/1), S2=(1/0), S3=(1/1), S4=(0/0).

observer_mode.description: Triadic observer stance: O1=field, O2=regime, O3=coherence, O4=apex.

regime_shell.description: RTT regime layer: R1=Regime-0, R2=Regime-1, R3=Regime-2, R4=Regime-3.

prime_state.description: Prime-indexed operator state mapped from (substrate_pair, observer_mode, regime_shell).

coordinates.description: Canonical coordinate triple (Si, Oj, Rk) defining one substrate primitive.

notes.description: Optional notes about this substrate primitive.
